name: @canonlayer/crawler-py
description: Self-hosted Crawl4AI worker — Python sibling of @canonlayer/crawler

scripts.dev: cross-env PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 PYTHONPATH=src py -3.12 -m uvicorn canonlayer_crawler.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8788
scripts.start: cross-env PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 PYTHONPATH=src py -3.12 -m uvicorn canonlayer_crawler.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8788
scripts.install:python: py -3.12 -m pip install -r requirements.txt && py -3.12 -m playwright install chromium
